oracle.name: Aang, Air Nomad
oracle.oracle_text:
Flying (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)
Other creatures you control have vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.

oracle.name: Aggressive Mammoth
oracle.oracle_text:
Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Other creatures you control have trample.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

oracle.name: Akroma's Devoted
oracle.oracle_text: Cleric creatures have vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.

oracle.name: Battering Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have trample.
oracle.flavor_text: Covered with hard shell-like plates, these slivers burrow through solid rock to carve out new nests for their hives.

oracle.name: Belligerent Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have menace. (They can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
oracle.flavor_text:
"The slivers became adept at provoking a fear response in other species."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

oracle.name: Bellowing Tanglewurm
oracle.oracle_text:
Intimidate (This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or creatures that share a color with it.)
Other green creatures you control have intimidate.

oracle.name: Bloodcrusher of Khorne
oracle.oracle_text:
Trample
Devastating Charge — Other creatures you control have trample.
oracle.flavor_text: The Brazen Thunder, foremost of the bloodcrusher legions, are named for the sound they make as they ride into battle.

oracle.name: Bloodmark Mentor
oracle.oracle_text: Red creatures you control have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text: Boggarts divide the world into two categories: things you can eat, and things you have to chase down and pummel before you can eat.

oracle.name: Blur Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have haste. (They can attack and {T} as soon as they come under your control.)
oracle.flavor_text: Traveling across the desert alone, you might assume you'd see them coming, but that would be your third mistake.

oracle.name: Bonescythe Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have double strike. (They deal both first-strike and regular combat damage.)
oracle.flavor_text:
"It seems docile enough. Perhaps we could train it to reap the grain—it would be the easiest harvest season of our lives!"
—Georgina, farmer, now deceased

oracle.name: Cloudshredder Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have flying and haste.
oracle.flavor_text: Forked tails rustled. Talons clicked. A lone sliver streaked overhead like jagged lightning, and the hive thundered.

oracle.name: Cryptothrall
oracle.oracle_text: Protector — Other artifact creatures you control have hexproof.
oracle.flavor_text: Bound to a cryptek, the cryptothrall exists for one reason: to defend its master to the death.

oracle.name: Cyclops of Eternal Fury
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have haste.
oracle.flavor_text:
"The anger that festers inside this one is contagious."
—Anthousa of Setessa

oracle.name: Felhide Petrifier
oracle.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Other Minotaur creatures you control have deathtouch.
oracle.flavor_text: It's common practice among minotaurs to collect the heads of their victims as trophies. Sometimes the trophies prove more than ornamental.

oracle.name: Fervor
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have haste. (They can attack and {T} as soon as they come under your control.)
oracle.flavor_text:
"We won't sit like lazy gob-slugs waiting for death to come to us. We'll bring death, shiny sharp, to our enemies."
—Krenko, mob boss

oracle.name: Fury Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have double strike.
oracle.flavor_text:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

oracle.name: Galerider Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have flying.
oracle.flavor_text:
"I wish we'd never visited that accursed hive. Even here, surrounded by nothing but clouds, I swear I can still hear the horrible clicking, slithering sounds."
—Monihan, aerial surveyor

oracle.name: Goblin War Drums
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have menace. (They can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
oracle.flavor_text: Their eardrums may have given out, but the rest of them never will.

oracle.name: Groundshaker Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have trample. (A creature with trample can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)

oracle.name: Heart Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have haste.
oracle.flavor_text: Gerrard looked all around for the source of the mysterious pulse, and at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

oracle.name: Herald of Dromoka
oracle.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Other Warrior creatures you control have vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text: The trumpeters of Arashin are ever alert in their watch over the Great Aerie.

oracle.name: Horned Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have trample.
oracle.flavor_text: A bristling wave of slivers broke against the Weatherlight's timbers.

oracle.name: Intimidation
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have fear. (They can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.)
oracle.flavor_text: "If they move, kill them. In fact, kill one now to make sure the other understands."

oracle.name: Khenra Charioteer
oracle.oracle_text:
Trample
Other creatures you control have trample.
oracle.flavor_text:
"We do not swerve."
—Tah-crop charioteer motto

oracle.name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
oracle.oracle_text: Knight creatures you control have double strike.
oracle.flavor_text: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

oracle.name: Knighthood
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text: Kings don't make knights. Actions do.

oracle.name: Kobold Overlord
oracle.oracle_text:
First strike
Other Kobold creatures you control have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text:
"One for all, all for one; we strike first, and then you're done!"
—Oath of the Kobold Musketeers

oracle.name: Krang, Utrom Warlord
oracle.oracle_text:
Flying, trample, indestructible, haste
Other artifact creatures you control have flying, trample, indestructible, and haste.
oracle.flavor_text: The Molecular Amplification technology of Krang's exo-suit allows him to expand and adapt not only his tactics, but his physical form.

oracle.name: Lancer Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text:
"These polearms were supposed to help!"
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

oracle.name: Levitation
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have flying.
oracle.flavor_text: "Why fight over scraps of land when there's so much sky waiting to be claimed?"

oracle.name: Madrush Cyclops
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have haste.
oracle.flavor_text: Death comes in the blink of an eye.

oracle.name: Mass Hysteria
oracle.oracle_text: All creatures have haste.
oracle.flavor_text: Gavony was their stage, and the moon their spotlight.

oracle.name: Nylea's Forerunner
oracle.oracle_text:
Trample
Other creatures you control have trample.
oracle.flavor_text: Where its feet tread, the thunder of many others will follow.

oracle.name: Primal Rage
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have trample. (A creature with trample can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)

oracle.name: Rage Reflection
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have double strike.
oracle.flavor_text: Make every blow count.

oracle.name: Reflex Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have haste.
oracle.flavor_text:
"This sliver comes into the world a perfect predator. It's ready to hunt and devour its first meal within seconds of hatching."
—Rukarumel, field journal

oracle.name: Rhox Pikemaster
oracle.oracle_text:
First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
Other Soldier creatures you control have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text: When the rhoxes charge, everyone else knows which way to run.

oracle.name: Roughshod Mentor
oracle.oracle_text: Green creatures you control have trample.
oracle.flavor_text: He didn't hear the cries of the treefolk whose branches he snapped or of the elves caught underfoot. He had eyes only for the path ahead.

oracle.name: Sentinel Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have vigilance. (Attacking doesn't cause them to tap.)
oracle.flavor_text:
"Nine hells! How does something with no eyes see so far?"
—Max, Benalish scout

oracle.name: Serra's Blessing
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have vigilance. (Attacking doesn't cause them to tap.)
oracle.flavor_text: "Rise, and I will show you how to run without flagging, fight without raging, and fly without wings."

oracle.name: Serra's Guardian
oracle.oracle_text:
Flying (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)
Other creatures you control have vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text: She watches over the city just as Serra watches over all.

oracle.name: Shadow Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have shadow. (They can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.)
oracle.flavor_text: These slivers, trapped between worlds since the Rathi overlay, are among the last to claim direct lineage from the lost Sliver Queen.

oracle.name: Sliver Hivelord
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have indestructible. (Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy them.)
oracle.flavor_text:
"This is the source, the line unbroken since the calamity that brought such monsters to our shores."
—Hastric, Thunian scout

oracle.name: Spinneret Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have reach.
oracle.flavor_text: Each new generation of slivers evolves to assimilate the strengths of the prey upon which their progenitors fed.

oracle.name: Spitting Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Our lances' reach had been our saving grace in our fight against the hive. Now even that advantage is taken from us."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish knight

oracle.name: Striking Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have first strike. (They deal combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
oracle.flavor_text: There is no such thing as surprising a sliver.

oracle.name: Sun Quan, Lord of Wu
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have horsemanship. (They can't be blocked except by creatures with horsemanship.)
oracle.flavor_text: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

oracle.name: Synchronous Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have vigilance.
oracle.flavor_text:
"With a twitch of its muscles, its timeline forks. Then, just as quickly, its two selves reintegrate. Causality, strangely, seems not to mind."
—Rukarumel, field journal

oracle.name: Syphon Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have lifelink. (Damage dealt by a Sliver creature you control also causes you to gain that much life.)
oracle.flavor_text: The hive knows no fear or mercy, only hunger.

oracle.name: Talon Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have first strike.
oracle.flavor_text: "Keep them at sword's length!" Gerrard's order fell flat as each sliver's talon suddenly grew longer. "Hold on—break out the polearms!"

oracle.name: True Conviction
oracle.oracle_text: Creatures you control have double strike and lifelink.
oracle.flavor_text: Dozens of spells known only to the Auriok elders were lost, but the next generation, galvanized by war, devised even more potent magic.

oracle.name: Tuktuk Rubblefort
oracle.oracle_text:
Defender, reach
Creatures you control have haste.
oracle.flavor_text: As with everything else, goblins believe fortifications benefit from as many spiky bits as possible.

oracle.name: Two-Headed Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have menace. (They can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
oracle.flavor_text: When a species becomes so dominant that no other can compete, evolution gets creative.

oracle.name: Venom Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: Sliver creatures you control have deathtouch. (Any amount of damage a creature with deathtouch deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)
oracle.flavor_text: The venom softens tissue and liquefies internal organs, allowing the slivers to feed freely without wasting time chewing.

oracle.name: Winged Sliver
oracle.oracle_text: All Sliver creatures have flying.
oracle.flavor_text:
"Everything around here has cut a deal with gravity."
—Gerrard of the Weatherlight
